_comment: TREND filter calibration (EMA regime gate on the entry side). Forces UseTrend=1 and sweeps the fast/slow EMA pair; SlowEMA also acts as the price floor and the EMAX bearish-cross exit slow line. Run only if the screen kept UseTrend ON. go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker SFIN -strategy reversion -interval Day1 -calibrate data/params/sfin/reversion_cal_trend.json -out ./reports/SFIN_trend -months 50 -test-months 12 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20
